title: DSPy Base Modules
summary: This module defines the foundational `BaseModule` for parameter management and state persistence, and the core `Module` class for building and executing DSPy programs with LM integration and lifecycle management.

nodes.label: BaseModule Class
nodes.title: BaseModule Class
nodes.description: Defines the foundational structure and common utilities for all DSPy modules, including parameter handling and state management.

nodes.label: Module Class
nodes.title: Module Class
nodes.description: The primary base class for all DSPy programs, extending BaseModule with execution logic, LM interaction, and callback support.

nodes.label: Manage Module Parameters
nodes.title: Manage Module Parameters
nodes.description: Provides methods to discover and iterate over all configurable parameters within a module, including nested structures.

nodes.label: Discover Sub-Modules
nodes.title: Discover Sub-Modules
nodes.description: Recursively identifies and lists all nested DSPy modules within a given module instance.

nodes.label: Serialize Module State
nodes.title: Serialize Module State
nodes.description: Handles saving the module's internal state to various formats (JSON, Pickle) and loading it back.

nodes.label: Copy Module Instances
nodes.title: Copy Module Instances
nodes.description: Implements deep copying mechanisms for modules, specifically handling parameters and allowing for state resets.

nodes.label: Execute Program Logic
nodes.title: Execute Program Logic
nodes.description: Orchestrates the synchronous and asynchronous execution of the module's forward method, integrating callbacks and usage tracking.

nodes.label: Configure Language Models
nodes.title: Configure Language Models
nodes.description: Manages the assignment and retrieval of Language Model clients for all Predict components within the module.

nodes.label: Manage Predictor Components
nodes.title: Manage Predictor Components
nodes.description: Provides utilities to find, list, and apply functions to dspy.Predict instances embedded within the module.

nodes.label: Batch Process Examples
nodes.title: Batch Process Examples
nodes.description: Enables parallel execution of the module's forward method across multiple input examples for efficiency.

nodes.label: Handle Callbacks & Events
nodes.title: Handle Callbacks & Events
nodes.description: Integrates a system for registering and invoking callback handlers during module execution for monitoring and instrumentation.

nodes.label: Track LM Usage
nodes.title: Track LM Usage
nodes.description: Monitors and records token usage and other metrics from Language Model calls made during module execution.

nodes.label: DSPy Parameter
nodes.title: DSPy Parameter
nodes.description: Represents a fundamental configurable unit within DSPy modules, managed by BaseModule.

nodes.label: DSPy Predict Module
nodes.title: DSPy Predict Module
nodes.description: A specialized DSPy module responsible for making predictions using a language model, managed by Module.

nodes.label: External LM Client
nodes.title: External LM Client
nodes.description: Represents an external Language Model client that DSPy modules interact with for generating responses.

nodes.label: DSPy Parallel Executor
nodes.title: DSPy Parallel Executor
nodes.description: An external utility for executing multiple module calls concurrently, used for batch processing.

groups.label: Core Module Definitions
groups.title: Core Module Definitions
groups.description: Defines the fundamental building blocks for all DSPy programs and modules.

groups.label: Module Structure & Introspection
groups.title: Module Structure & Introspection
groups.description: Capabilities for examining and navigating the internal structure and components of DSPy modules.

groups.label: Module Lifecycle & Persistence
groups.title: Module Lifecycle & Persistence
groups.description: Handles the creation, copying, and serialization of module states for saving and loading.

groups.label: Execution & Observability
groups.title: Execution & Observability
groups.description: Manages program execution flow, LM interactions, parallel processing, and monitoring features like callbacks and usage tracking.
